content: Craft Feed Me: feed = name, source, type (CSV/JSON/XML/...), element type, then a mapping table of three columns — Field | Feed Element (dropdown incl. 'Don't import') | Default Value — plus a checkbox column marking which fields form the unique identifier. Import strategy: add new, update existing, disable missing, delete missing; 'Set Empty Values' decides whether a blank column clears an existing value; optional backup before the run.
